preparation.rule: New experiment after prefix-only regressed production SG16. Compare the exact original against 256 GRF alone and 256 GRF plus the screened prefix changes. Both SG16 and SG32, fused Q8, 36 independent states, A/B/A/B/A, three warmup and nine retained batches of eight sweeps. Same numerical rule per process: every shape has both baseline drifts <=3%; no-prefix shape gains >=-1%, pooled no-prefix gain >=1%, every prefix gain >=0%. A screen must pass both subgroup modes. Prefer the smaller GRF-only change if it qualifies; otherwise replay+GRF. Two fresh confirmations in each subgroup mode must all pass. Then remove renaming macros, compile the final public API independently, differential-check and confirm in two more fresh processes per subgroup. Existing GDN regressions and native GRF audit required. No deployment.
